data.translation: Father Brahim: Well, in our neighbourhood there was Maqsi Musa; he had two hives. We ourselves used to raise them; we had two beehives, a big one and a small one.

summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 4.II/720)

data.turoyo: W kəbʕono d bədyono me gabax Sawim. I ʕlaymṯo du ʕamayḏan iḏiʕo yo, kmirabyo b šəkəl ḥreno d kmirabe u ʕlaymo?
data.translation: And I want to begin with you, Sawim. The young woman of our people, it is known, is she brought up in a different way from the way the young man is brought up?

rationale: II Detransitive Infectum has two round 1 examples; feminine/masculine contrast supports patient-centered upbringing.

summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 4.II/811)

data.translation: Ninorta: I believe this matter comes from how one is brought up, from childhood, from the time one is born.

rationale: II Detransitive Infectum still thin; generic upbringing from childhood without overt raiser.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 4.II/978)

data.turoyo: ʕAṭiya: Bas u qanunano, Nənwe hat hawət harke, mrabət harke, Beṯ-Nahrin hič lo ḥəzyolax, klozəm u qanunano d qudrina mbadliwaynale ʕam ḥḏoḏe?
data.translation: Atiya: But this rule, Nenwe, you were born here, you were brought up here, you have never seen Mesopotamia; should we have been able to change this rule together?

rationale: First II Detransitive Preterit; birth and local upbringing of a feminine addressee.

summary: I rabi denotes growth with the growing participant as subject; II mrabe denotes raising/nourishing with a raiser and an expressed or indexed patient. Animals, humans and divine agents fit the inherited broad gloss.

II mi- Infectum (69/252–253; JTM 1.2/19) fills a previously absent Detransitive box. Existing mrabyo Part. Pass. presents the resulting reared/tame state (70/107). Maternal context permits either development or implicit raising; it does not justify an independent new anticausative sense.
69/19 uses Preterit in a prospective condition, so morphology is retained despite German conditional wording. Preterit-wa 76/2 is already cited and is not added again.
ʕal iḏi/iḏo specifies personal or hand rearing (52/53; 70/107); it does not create a specialized idiom. No light-verb construction is established.
The claim that 73/202 is absent misreads a note attached to the 115/150 reference. Keep this verified embedded example; question the unresolved bare rabi citation separately.
All 31 records reviewed, including Arabic speech and repeated predicates. New output contains only round 2 changes; round 1 Detransitive 1 is not proposed again.

New active II Infectum-wa is provisionally distinguished from inherited Preterit-wa. Mrabewolle an naʕimayḏa lacks mi- and permits unspecified plural raisers despite patient-centered English. Source voice in English is not morphological evidence.

Read-only lookup rwy shows rwy 1 rawi/rowe with the same MEA rby etymology, distinct from drunkenness rwy 2. yarəw/yərwi and mawrəwi cannot safely multiply rby stems. No entry merger or duplicate-entry correction is forced.
Lookup r confirms Rbn mrabanle/mraban, with mrabanwa under Infectum. Lexical n in mrabanwo differs from personal -na- in mrabenawo. Partridge/bird forms are withheld from rby.
Building enlargement mərwiwola changes the event from nurturing to size increase; it is not automatically a participant extension. Root/stem uncertainty prevents a new numbered sense.

Imperativ mrabawunxunyo has plural self-beneficiary and masculine baby object. Detransitive kmirabyo/kmirabe and mrabət present upbringing without a named raiser. No fixed light-verb expression emerges.
Added box labels normalize the reader’s Detransitive prefix into the separate Detransitive flag. All added English remains verbatim project machine translation, cut with <...>.
Does mirabən at JTM 1.2/19 mean growth itself or being raised by the mother? mi- morphology is secure, its prominence is open.
Does kəmrabən in the cannibal-restaurant passage entail fattening, or only feeding/keeping alive? No technical sense is accepted without further evidence.
Can editors locate bare rabi at the inherited 115/150 citation? Supplied 115/50 has rabina and cannot automatically replace it.
At 85/19, are the implicit raisers the replacement goats or the villagers? The inherited broad grossziehen/nähren gloss covers either.
What precisely is the role of eli at 88/16? No unsupported analysis of its object coding is adopted.
Reconcile rby with rwy 1: are yarəw/yərwi and causative mawrəwi regular variants or separately indexed material? Where does building enlargement mərwiwola belong?
Resolve weak-final mrabe versus Rbn mraban, including partridge/bird mrabanwo and the other entry’s Infectum heading containing -wa. No change to that other entry is made.
Is inherited rby.II.t.preterit-wa.1 mrabe-way-le correctly Preterit-wa or an Infectum-wa form? Jan’s mrabewo series warrants review, but no automatic move is made.
Confirm active unspecified-plural Mrabewolle at Jan 1.8/208 versus reduced Detransitive, and segment mrabawunxunyo at Jan 1.21/1067.
Does Jan 2.12/3145 refer to bees or colonies/hives as nurtured object? Confirm 1pl -na- in mrabenawo at Jan 1.26/1272.
